To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the dual coactions on cross-sectional alge- bras of Fell bundles are always maximal, and that the full cross-sectional algebra of a Fell bundle over a K-amenable group is always K-amenable.

the dual of any coaction on a C*-algebra is maximal, that the dual of a coaction on any Fell bundle is maximal, that any Fell bundle is the full cross section of a Fell bundle over a discrete group, and that any Fell bundle has a dual Fell bundle.

we give a simple new proof of the maximally of the dual coaction on the full cross-sectional C∗-algebra of Fell bundles over groups, that we extend certain exotic cross-product functors in Baum, Guentners and Willetts sense from partial actions to Fell bundles and that we give a characterizaton of the maximal coactions of locally compact groups in terms of tensor products.
